summary.text: Kirk Haston is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 72, which covers Chester, Decatur and Perry counties and parts of Hardin and Henderson counties, who lives in Lobelville, took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a school health coordinator.

paragraphs.text: Haston was born on March 10, 1979, earned a B.S. in sports management from Indiana University in 2002 and a master's degree in arts and education from Cumberland University in 2012.

The legislature's biography lists him as a school health coordinator and notes service on the Perry County Health Council and the boards of the Southwest Human Resource Agency and the Perry Council on Aging.
Haston has been a member of the House since the 111th General Assembly and chairs the K-12 Subcommittee.
He is also a member of the Commerce and Education committees.
